## 1. Project snapshot

- **What**: {{display_name}} — an Apple app built from `template-apple-swift`.
  Components enabled at onboarding: {{enabled_list}}.
- **Runtime**: Swift 6 (language mode 6.0), SwiftUI, `@Observable`, SwiftData
  where enabled. Deployment floors: {{floors}}.
  Build SDK is the latest stable Xcode (26.x); XcodeGen ≥ 2.46.0.
- **Identity**: `{{app_name}}` · `{{bundle_root}}` · App Group `{{app_group}}`.
- **Non-goals**: the Xcode project is a build artifact — `project.yml` is the

  Every `Info.plist` and `.entitlements` is generated from YAML and gitignored;

- **Isolation**: every type carries `@MainActor` or `nonisolated` explicitly, so
  the sources compile identically under either `SWIFT_DEFAULT_ACTOR_ISOLATION`.
